item.text: {"summary":"A large deciduous tree native to the Balkans, horse-chestnut has fallen-leaf scars shaped like horseshoes with seven “nails.” Its spring flowers are usually white with yellow-to-pink markings, followed by green spiky fruits containing glossy brown conkers.","humanEdibility":"no","edibilityNote":"Raw seeds, leaves, bark and flowers are toxic and should not be eaten; young, fresh seeds can cause sickness.","evidence":{"summary":["s1:p2","s1:p3","s1:p6"],"humanEdibility":["s1:p10","s1:p20"]}}
